page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance from the Enhanced family built on KVM hypervisor technology. It features 32 vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, with 2 threads per core. Cache configuration includes 48 KB L1d cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 48 MB L3 cache per socket structure. System memory totals 64.0 GB, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU allocation. The instance does not include local NVMe storage or dedicated GPU accelerators, relying on network storage while providing a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark metrics reflect consistent mid-tier performance across general processing and memory workloads. The instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1584.0 and multi-core score of 13347.0, with dedicated PassMark CPU performance measuring 36657.12. Synthetic stress testing via stress-ng yields 1860.49 for single-core and 31104.89 for multi-core processing. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 151.74 GB/sec while write bandwidth sits at 66.82 GB/sec. In application-specific metrics, static web serving throughput reaches 33.38 GB/sec and Redis SET performance delivers 31.2 million operations per second. Light LLM text generation with a 135M parameter model shows strong output at 310.19 tokens/sec.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio presents a dedicated hardware profile optimized for compute-heavy tasks rather than memory-intensive applications. Because local storage is absent, all persistent I/O relies entirely on network interface capacity. The instance delivers solid qualitative cost efficiency for compute-focused processing, compiler pipelines, web traffic distribution, and small-model CPU inference. Appropriate workloads include CI/CD software compilation, web serving, key-value caching, and parallel compute jobs that fit within 64.0 GB of RAM.
